clips.title: South Korea just passed Britain and France (IMF, 2026) #Shorts
clips.desc: GDP per person, PPP: 1990 Korea $7.7k vs UK $18.3k. 2026: Korea $70.3k, France $68.9k, UK $68.5k (IMF WEO Oct 2026).

clips.title: Why South Korea got rich: it never stopped making things #Shorts
clips.desc: Manufacturing is about a quarter of Korea's economy, under a tenth in Britain (World Bank).
